aiControl.title: AI Center
aiControl.sub: Every AI agent: what it is doing, what it cost, what it decided.
aiControl.offBody: Off on a new installation until the owner turns it on. With AI off nothing is sent to any AI company, and every AI feature falls back to its rule or saved template — the shop keeps running as normal.

agents.title: Agents
agents.sub: Each agent's own switch; the master switch above decides whether any of them may actually work.
agents.readOnly: You can see the agents; pausing or resuming one needs the AI control permission.
